I've answered Hollis in our direct message: his first call should be Pree Sundaram.

- **Why Pree:** Tansley Parcel is her account. His own H2 2025 territory plan calls it "Pree's biggest account." She also ran the last Tansley Parcel incident in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: a carrier API and label-printing outage on 3 Sep 2025, fixed the same day.
- **Customer contact:** The only Tansley Parcel contact I can see in Hollis's channels is Lev Arkadin. Pree linked him to the account in #central-team (Tulsa hub). He's also mentioned in the incident room, but the message there doesn't name the company.
- **What's missing:** I found no phone numbers, on-call rota or support escalation path for the account. I said so plainly and gave him Pree's directory email (psundaram@pemberline.com) and Slack.
- **Tip I added:** Hollis has said before that "TP" in the triage queue gets mixed up with Tansleigh Packaging and pages the wrong on-call. So I suggested he write the full account name. I also mentioned that #inc-tansley-carrier-api already includes him, Pree and Tobias if this becomes a live incident.

I only looked at what Hollis can see himself: his channels (#central-team, #inc-tansley-carrier-api and our direct message), public files and the member directory. Nothing needed approval, and I didn't contact anyone else.
